title: Beetle Queen Ritual
description: A central female figure with closed eyes wears an ornate crown of golden circles and a large beetle. Her dark robe is adorned with multiple beetles, circular symbols, and crosses. She is flanked by two hooded figures with antlers, one on each side, against a background split between light and dark with glowing orbs.
prompt: A surreal occult scene featuring a central serene woman with closed eyes wearing a golden crown of circles topped with a large beetle, her dark robe covered in beetles, crosses, and circular symbols. She stands between two robed hooded figures with large antlers, one on each side, performing a ritual. The background transitions from light watercolor with blue and yellow bokeh orbs on the left to solid black on the right, with glowing particles and insects at the base.
